questions.q: What was Kiribati called as a British colony?
questions.why: It became independent in 1979.

questions.q: What did Kiribati do to the date line in 1995?
questions.a: Moved it so all its islands share the same day
wrong: Created a new time zone for Hawaii
questions.why: Its eastern islands had been a day behind.

questions.q: Which 1943 battle saw US Marines fight Japanese forces in Kiribati?
questions.why: It was one of the bloodiest Pacific battles.

questions.q: Which island was mined for phosphate until 1979?
questions.why: Its people were moved to Fiji.

questions.q: Who was the first President of Kiribati?
questions.why: He was only 29.

questions.q: What is the capital of Kiribati?
questions.why: Most government offices are on it.

questions.q: Which country is the only one in all four hemispheres?
questions.why: It crosses the equator and the 180th meridian.

questions.q: Which Kiribati island is among the first places to see each new year?
questions.why: It is in the UTC+14 time zone.

questions.q: Which threat endangers Kiribati's low atolls?
questions.why: Most land is just a few metres above sea.

questions.q: Which island group in the middle of Kiribati is a huge marine reserve?
questions.why: It is one of the world's largest protected areas.

questions.q: Which ocean is Kiribati in?
questions.why: It spreads over 3.5 million square kilometres of sea.

questions.q: Which atoll is the world's largest by land area?
questions.why: It is a top bonefishing spot.

questions.q: Which open-sided meeting house is central to Kiribati villages?
questions.why: Each family has a seat in it.

questions.q: Which root crop is grown in pits on the atolls?
questions.why: It is eaten at feasts.

questions.q: Which Kiribati island group is furthest east, near Hawaii?
questions.why: Kiritimati is one of them.

questions.q: Which sport is very popular in Kiribati?
questions.why: Weightlifting has also had success.

questions.q: Which Kiribati weightlifter danced after his lifts at the Olympics?
questions.why: He danced to draw attention to climate change.

questions.q: Who has been President of Kiribati since 2016?
questions.why: He was re-elected in 2020 and 2024.

questions.q: Which President became famous for warning about climate change?
questions.why: He bought land in Fiji as a safeguard.

questions.q: Which traditional dance uses bird-like arm movements?
questions.why: Dancers copy the frigatebird.

questions.q: Which currency is used in Kiribati?
questions.why: It also has its own coins.

questions.q: How is Kiribati pronounced?
questions.why: 'Ti' is said like 's'.

questions.q: Which British H-bomb tests took place near Kiritimati?
questions.why: They were held in 1957–58.

questions.q: What is the main language spoken in Kiribati?
questions.why: English is also official.

questions.q: Which tree gives Kiribati food, drink and building material?
questions.why: Copra is a main export.

questions.q: Which seabird is on Kiribati's flag?
questions.why: It flies over a rising sun.

questions.q: Which fishing is famous on Kiritimati?
questions.why: Anglers come from all over the world.

questions.q: Which wartime relics remain on Betio islet?
questions.why: They date from 1943.

questions.q: Which fish is a key export?
questions.why: Foreign fleets pay to fish there.

questions.q: Which body armour was made from coconut fibre?
questions.why: Warriors also wore helmets of pufferfish skin.
